title: Everything You Need to Know About Junk Bonds
author: Unknown
content: You need to know how long you can commit your cash before you decide to buy a junk bond fund. Many do not allow investors to cash out for at least one or two years. The simple reason to buy a junk bond is for higher returns. Junk bonds are risky assets but due to their high risk, they come with returns that are higher than safer, investment-grade bonds. Investors willing to take on higher risk for higher returns would buy junk bonds. The primary disadvantage of a junk bond is the issuer defaulting on the bond. Junk bonds are issued by companies or countries that are low-rated. There is a high chance that the issuer may not be able to make the interest payments on the bond or that they may go bankrupt and not only not make payments but not repurchase the bond at maturity. Junk bonds are bonds that have a rating of BB or lower by S&P or Ba and lower by Moody's. Any bonds with these ratings are junk bonds.
